title: University Open Day

lines.text: Welcome to the Greenfield University Open Day.
The day starts at nine thirty in the main hall.

title: A Violinist in the Square

lines.text: Fatima, you play the violin in the street. When did you start?
I started when I was seven. My uncle taught me.
Where do you play?
Mostly in the main square, near the fountain.
How often do you play?
Every afternoon from four to six, except on Mondays.
Do people give you money?
Yes, sometimes. But I mainly play because I love music.
Do you study music too?
Yes, I'm in my second year at the music school.
What's your dream?
I'm going to play with a big orchestra one day.

title: A Childhood by the Sea

lines.text: When I was a child, I lived in a small village near the sea.
My house had a big garden with two apple trees.
I didn't have a computer, so I played outside every day.
My best friend was Karim. We built a boat from old wood.
The boat wasn't good, and it sank in the first minute!
We laughed a lot, and our mothers weren't happy.
In winter, we went to the market with my father.
He sold fish, and I helped him count the money.
I miss those days, but I love my life now.
